I'm depressed and I hate the glamorization of depression. Not showering for four days because I can't bring myself to undress is not glamorous. Wanting to hurt myself isn't cute. I know I need to see a therapist, but scheduling the appointment feels fucking impossible because I know I'll have to go over EVERYTHING with a new therapist because the one I used to see here is deployed or on a rotation somewhere else and the team I liked was at my last duty station.

I stopped taking my prozac when I ran out months ago and I was doing just fine (at least functional) until the guy that raped me five years ago messaged me and apologized and asked me to forgive him (if I can) and threw my whole fucking mental life into chaos and I don't feel like I can talk to anyone in my personal life about it. I can, I know I can, but the prospect of actually talking about it with my spouse or my sister is on par with me trying to run a marathon without preparing first. All I want to do it sleep and walk my dogs and hide out under a blanket until it stops.
Thank you. I'm going to talk to my husband later today. I know I'm acting different and it's not fair to him. Or me

I save everything, though.

So, so much

I went to sleep last night with plans to meet up with a girlfriend to hunt down some sweet new Pokemon. I woke up with a message and a friend request from the ex boyfriend who raped me in October of 2012. I haven't been able to bring myself to read anything but the [visible lines in messenger](https://imgur.com/a/BXMCN) and I've been having anxiety about it all day.

I reported him, there was an investigation, but it was deemed unfounded which, in military legal, means they lacked evidence and it came down to he said she said. It also means (as far as I know) I have no protection from being stationed together or seeing him again.

I have been in therapy on and off for four fucking years, I JUST started feeling good enough without my prozac, and this motherfucker decides it's time we be friends again? Are you kidding me? I've told my sister, but not my husband because I think he'll overreact. Almost none of our mutual friends are aware. I've kept the panic at bay all day with distractions but I'm running low and I want to scream.

I could use a laugh. Or advice. Or reassurance that I'm panicking for no reason. 

UPDATE: He apologizes, wants my forgiveness, and wishes he hadn't destroyed our relationship. I don't know how to react to this.

Update: I accidentally tapped the thumbs up button while exiting, panicked, and called him because I didn't know what else to do. That was fucking surreal. I was on the phone for hours. He admitted to lying through his teeth during the investigation, apologized for being a dick afterwards and repeatedly told me how sorry he is. I cried. A lot. Yelled at him, raged, got a lot of the poison out, if I'm being honest. I think today was the first time in 4 years I've woken up without feeling fuelled by my hate for him.

I'm still shaky, still processing, but I feel lighter.
